Reasoning: When S=1, the MUX selects the lower input terminal, so what is sent to the output is the inverted signal of the feedback output Y. After another 10 ns, it changes back to its original value. Therefore Y toggles once every 10 ns, the half-period is 10 ns, and the full period is 20 ns. The frequency f = 1/(20 ns) = 50 MHz. Therefore the output is a square wave, with frequency 50 MHz.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify that when S=1 the MUX chooses the lower input, which is the inverted version of the output feedback Y. Therefore after the MUX propagation delay, Y becomes the complement of its previous value. Starting with either initial value, after 10 ns Y flips; after another 10 ns it flips back. Thus the waveform alternates high and low with half-period 10 ns, total period 20 ns, so the frequency is 1/20 ns = 50 MHz. State that Y is a square wave.

图像描述：图中是一个 2×1 MUX，左侧上输入端标为 0，左侧下输入端标为 1，底部是选择端 S，右侧输出为 Y。输出 Y 通过反馈线直接接到上输入端 0，同时该反馈信号经过左侧的反相器后接到下输入端 1。
